label: Map-projection computation, 1962–1974
basis: L. P. Lee published on transverse Mercator computation in 1962 and 1963. His 1974 Pacific-projection paper identifies him as Chief Computer at the Department of Lands and Survey in Wellington. This work belongs to the mathematical and coordinate-computation foundations later used in digital mapping.

sources.label: L. P. Lee, The Transverse Mercator Projection of the Entire Spheroid, Empire Survey Review 16(123), 1962, pp.208–217
L. P. Lee, A Conformal Projection for the Map of the Pacific, New Zealand Geographer 30(1), 1974; author affiliation: Chief Computer, Department of Lands and Survey
Snyder and Steward, Bibliography of map projections, USGS Bulletin 1856, 1988
